findings.title: sysid two-state fit rolls the candidate with one Euler step per 30-min sample: UA 17-25% low on an exact continuous plant, 0/3 presets adopt
findings.claim: On a noise-free truth plant with exactly the declared preset parameters integrated finely (30 substeps per 30-min sample), the production identify_slab fit returns UA -16.8% (light_new) and -25.5% (heavy_old) and refuses typical_slab, so 3 of 3 presets are biased >5% or refused and 0 of 3 are adopted; with the truth integrated at the fit's own 0.5 h Euler step the bias is 0.0 and 2 of 3 adopt.
findings.mechanism: _simulate_slab_path -> _valve_drive -> ThermalModel.simulate_step(dt_hours=sample interval) is one explicit-Euler step of 0.5 h per sample; the fit identifies the parameters of the 0.5 h Euler map, not of the continuous house (and not of the optimizer's own 0.25 h step: truth at 2 substeps gives -8.9/-10.9/-23.3%). The biased fit's residual flattens the profile, so the #1410 gate refuses it as 'interval unbounded' and the published heat_loss_kw_per_c carries the biased value.

evidence.unit: count (presets of 3 with |UA bias|>5% or refused, 30-substep truth)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to 3 finders on the box; deterministic noise-free count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --substep-rollout: sysid._valve_drive replaced in memory by the same call split into 6 equal sub-steps (one-line production edit)

findings.metric_definition: Presets (of 3) whose production sysid UA, on a noise-free truth == declared params integrated at 30 substeps per 30-min sample, has |UA/UA_true-1|>5% or no completed fit.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every parameter fit that rolls a candidate ThermalModel over recorded samples must integrate the candidate at a resolution whose discretization error is small against the adoption bar, independent of the coordinator's sample cadence.

null_control.value: truth at the fit's own 0.5 h Euler step: heavy_old +0.00000 adopted, typical_slab +0.00000 adopted
null_control.note: the bias vanishes when truth and candidate share the discretization; a free two-state fit with a 1-min rollout recovers UA to 1e-5 on all three presets

reproduction_steps: Run the command; read RESULT slab_bias_*_sub30 and continuous_presets_*
findings.proposed_fix_scope: sysid.py: sub-step the candidate rollout in _simulate_slab_path/_valve_drive (and the sizer's _predict_step_excursion_plant) to a fixed fine dt independent of the sample interval; re-measure the interval gate on the presets.

findings.title: Defrost derate fallback folds meter ratios that _cop_fold_blocked refuses to the COP learner (immersion, backup heater, capacity cap)
findings.claim: On a flag-less install with a power meter in the frost band, _record_accuracy -> _settle_defrost -> DefrostDerate.observe folds the commanded/measured ratio on 3 of 3 draw-distorting contaminations for which _cop_fold_blocked is True and _learn_measured_cop refuses, walking the published derate to 0.874 after 12 h of backup-heater running.
findings.mechanism: _record_accuracy gates _settle_defrost only on _learning_frozen(power) in (None, 'defrosting'); the immersion latch and PumpElectricHeat.compressor_draw_distorted are not freeze reasons, and _settle_defrost does not consult _cop_fold_blocked, although the derate fallback reads the same meter ratio the COP learner does.

evidence.unit: count (distorting arms of 3 the derate folds)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to 3 finders on the box; deterministic count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --gate-derate: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._settle_defrost wrapped in memory to return when coordinator._cop_fold_blocked(self)
perturbation.observed_value: derate_ingests_distorted 3 -> 0; contaminated-arm factor stays 1.0000; clean control still folds

findings.metric_definition: Number of the 3 draw-distorting arms (immersion latch, backup heater, capacity limited) on which one settled interval increments DefrostDerate.counts while _cop_fold_blocked is True.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every learner that folds the heat pump meter's commanded/measured ratio must refuse the intervals _cop_fold_blocked marks as not describing the compressor.
reproduction_steps: Run the command; read RESULT derate_ingest_* and derate_factor_after_24_*
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py _record_accuracy/_settle_defrost: skip the fallback observe (the inferred path) when _cop_fold_blocked(self); the measured-duty path is unaffected.
